newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics adds x2 Internet providers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics adds x2 Internet providers.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Monday about 100 Internet service providers now support its x2 modem technology, which alllow users to receive information nearly twice as fast as the common modem now available.

U.S. Robotics said it has recently added more than 60 providers supporting the technology. The list includes regional and national Internet service providers and online services in the United States and other countries, which have a total of more than 16 million subscribers, it said.
The x2 technology allows users to receive information at a rate of 56 kilobits per second, nearly twice as fast as the common 28.8 kbps modem available today.
